sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 2020
ACT XVII OF 2020
SINDH COVID-19 EMERGENCY RELIEF
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Sindh Covid-19
Emergency Relief Act, 2020
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-16/2020, dated 12.8.2020.---The Sindh COVID-19 Emergency Relief (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th July, 2020 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 05th August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS to amend the Sindh Covid-19 Emergency
Relief Act, 2020, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Covid-19 Emergency Relief (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-16/2020, dated 12.8.2020.---The Sindh COVID-19 Emergency Relief (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th July, 2020 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 05th August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS to amend the Sindh Covid-19 Emergency
Relief Act, 2020, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 3 of Sindh Act No. XII of 2020.---In the Sindh Covid-19 Emergency Relief Act, 2020, in section 3 -
(i) in
subsection (2), after clause (g), the following new clauses shall be added:-
"(h)
the Health Department, Government of Sindh shall motivate and encourage the
people to conduct Covid-19 tests at prescribed health facilities free of cost
in the Province through mass awareness campaign, workshops, seminars,
electronic and print media;
(ii) any
person employed at any establishment who is tested positive for Covid-19 shall
be allowed paid-leave for the period he remains in isolation and shall follow
the Standard Operating Procedures prescribed by the Health Department during
isolation; provided that Government shall provide financial assistance to daily
wage workers who test positive and shall follow Standard Operating Procedures
prescribed by the Health Department during the isolation period.";
(iii) after
subsection (6), the following new sub-section shall be added:-
"(7)
It shall be mandatory for the person who visits any public place to wear face
mask for the prescribed period to mitigate the spread of infection of
Covid-19.".
